---
title: "Fluorescence figures: time series and station comparison"
output: html_notebook
---

Makes two figures from the corrected fluorescence product
(`fluorescence_correction_pipeline.Rmd`):

1. **Time series** (`panel_kc10_interp_2025-11-25_no-density.png`): a Hovmöller
   of monthly-median fluorescence (0-30 m) above monthly 0-30 m integrated
   chlorophyll with anomalies from the monthly climatology.
2. **Station comparison** (`integrated_comparison_station.png`): 0-30 m
   integrated chlorophyll at KC10 vs FZH01 on dates both were sampled.

**Integration method.** Each profile is integrated over 0-30 m with the
trapezoidal rule. Profiles are averaged to one value per station per day, then
per month for the time series. Profiles that don't cover the 0-30 m layer are
excluded (`min_top`, `min_bottom` below) so shallow or partial casts don't bias
the integrals low.

**Changes from the earlier plotting notebook** (these change the figures):

- **Monthly integrals were wrong.** The old code sorted all of a month's
  profiles together by depth before summing, so each month's value was
  effectively one profile (the last listed at each depth), not a monthly mean.
  Now each profile is integrated, then averaged.
- **Stations were pooled.** The old time series mixed KC10 and FZH01 (both in
  the Hovmöller medians and the integrals) despite the KC10 file name. It now
  uses `ts_station`; set it to `c("KC10", "FZH01")` to pool deliberately.
- **Units.** Depth-integrated chlorophyll is mg m⁻² (the old label said
  mg m⁻² × m).
- **Colour scale.** The breakpoints at 2, 5, 10, 20 mg m⁻³ are now fixed
  (`limits = c(0, 50)`). Before, they were relative to each plot's data range,
  so they only matched those values when the data happened to span 0-50.

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(akima) # interp() for the Hovmöller grid

ctd_fl <- read_csv(here("outputs", "flu_qc_2026-10-13.csv")) # pipeline output

ts_station <- "KC10"  # station(s) for the time series
int_depth  <- 30      # integrate 0 to this depth (dbar)
min_top    <- 2       # profile must start at or above this depth...
min_bottom <- 29      # ...and reach at least this depth to be integrated
```

## Integrated chlorophyll

```{r integrate}
# Trapezoidal integral over the non-missing points of one profile
integrate_profile <- function(pres, value) {
  o <- order(pres)
  pres <- pres[o]
  value <- value[o]
  if (length(pres) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  sum(diff(pres) * (head(value, -1) + tail(value, -1)) / 2)
}

profile_int <- ctd_fl %>%
  filter(pres <= int_depth, !is.na(f_final)) %>%
  group_by(id, date, station) %>%
  summarise(int_chla = integrate_profile(pres, f_final),
            top = min(pres),
            bottom = max(pres),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(complete = top <= min_top & bottom >= min_bottom)

cat("Profiles excluded for incomplete 0-", int_depth, " m coverage: ",
    sum(!profile_int$complete), " of ", nrow(profile_int), "\n", sep = "")

# One value per station per day (averages sensors if more than one that day)
station_daily <- profile_int %>%
  filter(complete) %>%
  group_by(date, station) %>%
  summarise(int_chla = mean(int_chla), n_profiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

monthly_int <- station_daily %>%
  filter(station %in% ts_station) %>%
  mutate(year_month = floor_date(date, "month"),
         month = month(date)) %>%
  group_by(year_month, month) %>%
  summarise(int_chla = mean(int_chla), n_days = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  mutate(climatology = mean(int_chla),
         anomaly = int_chla - climatology) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Figure 1: time series

```{r hovmoller-grid}
# Monthly median profile, placed on the 15th of the month
hov_monthly <- ctd_fl %>%
  filter(station %in% ts_station, pres <= int_depth, !is.na(f_final)) %>%
  mutate(year_month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(year_month, pres) %>%
  summarise(f_final = median(f_final), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(date = year_month + days(14))

# Linear interpolation onto a regular date x depth grid. Gaps between sampled
# months are filled linearly, so long gaps will look smoother than the data.
date_seq <- seq(min(hov_monthly$date), max(hov_monthly$date), length.out = 300)
pres_seq <- seq(0, int_depth, length.out = 200)

grid <- with(hov_monthly,
             interp(x = as.numeric(date), y = pres, z = f_final,
                    xo = as.numeric(date_seq), yo = pres_seq))

interp_df <- expand.grid(date = date_seq, pres = pres_seq) %>%
  mutate(f_final = as.vector(grid$z)) %>%
  filter(pres > 0, pres < int_depth)
```

```{r fig-timeseries}
fluor_colours <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#08306b", "#1f4e7a", "#2e6b89", "#4d8fc7", "#2fb3d4", "#00a693",
  "#4daf4a", "#8cc152", "#ffd23f", "#ff8c42", "#e74c3c"
))(50)

x_limits <- range(c(interp_df$date, monthly_int$year_month), na.rm = TRUE)
x_scale <- scale_x_date(expand = c(0, 0), date_breaks = "1 year",
                        date_labels = "%Y", limits = x_limits)

panel_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        text = element_text(color = "black", size = 25),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

p_hov <- ggplot(interp_df, aes(x = date, y = pres, fill = f_final)) +
  geom_raster() +
  x_scale +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 5)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = fluor_colours,
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50)),
    limits = c(0, 50), oob = scales::squish,
    na.value = "white",
    name = expression(Chl~(mg~m^-3)),
    guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "right",
                           title.theme = element_text(angle = 270, hjust = 0.5, size = 20))
  ) +
  labs(y = "Depth (m)") +
  panel_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank())

p_int <- ggplot(monthly_int, aes(x = year_month)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = anomaly, fill = anomaly > 0), alpha = 0.7, width = 20) +
  geom_line(aes(y = int_chla), color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = int_chla), color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "blue"), guide = "none") +
  x_scale +
  labs(y = expression(atop("0-30 m integrated", Chl~(mg~m^-2)))) +
  panel_theme

timeseries_plot <- p_hov / p_int
timeseries_plot

ggsave(here("figures", "panel_kc10_interp_2026-10-13.png"),
       timeseries_plot, width = 16, height = 8)
```

## Figure 2: station comparison

```{r fig-station-comparison}
comparison_data <- station_daily %>%
  filter(station %in% c("KC10", "FZH01")) %>%
  select(date, station, int_chla) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = station, values_from = int_chla,
              names_prefix = "integrated_") %>%
  filter(!is.na(integrated_KC10), !is.na(integrated_FZH01))

cor_test <- cor.test(comparison_data$integrated_KC10, comparison_data$integrated_FZH01)
lm_fit <- lm(integrated_FZH01 ~ integrated_KC10, data = comparison_data)

stats_text <- paste0(
  "r = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 3), "\n",
  "p = ", format.pval(cor_test$p.value, digits = 3), "\n",
  "R² = ", round(summary(lm_fit)$r.squared, 3), "\n",
  "slope = ", round(coef(lm_fit)[2], 3), "\n",
  "n = ", nrow(comparison_data)
)

axis_limits <- range(c(comparison_data$integrated_KC10,
                       comparison_data$integrated_FZH01), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(comparison_data, aes(x = integrated_KC10, y = integrated_FZH01)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7, color = "#2E86AB") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#A23B72",
              fill = "#A23B72", alpha = 0.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = axis_limits[1] + diff(axis_limits) * 0.05,
           y = axis_limits[2] - diff(axis_limits) * 0.05,
           label = stats_text, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_limits, ylim = axis_limits) +
  labs(x = expression(KC10~"0-30 m integrated Chl"~(mg~m^-2)),
       y = expression(FZH01~"0-30 m integrated Chl"~(mg~m^-2)),
       title = "Integrated chlorophyll: KC10 vs FZH01",
       subtitle = "Daily station means on dates both stations were sampled",
       caption = "Dashed line = 1:1") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(here("figures", "integrated_comparison_station_2026-10-13.png"), width = 9, height = 6)
```
